evidence.title: Ranger Epic Quest
evidence.interpretation: Ranger walkthrough explicitly requires one each listed component and the named output. Hardened Mixture retains Shiny Tin Bowl; Runecrested Bowl uses pottery wheel with no skill required. Existing enabled/no-fail/no-learning/non-replacement metadata is preserved, not a new runtime crafting claim.

limits: Exact unchanged baseline structural expectation. No real Combine, inventory settlement, failure or learning-bit execution verified.
